title: Idaho National Guard, Boise Fire Department train on helicopter hoist rescues
description: The Boise Fire Department conducted hoist training with the Idaho Army National Guard's state aviation group and their Black Hawk UH-60 helicopters Nov. 3rd, 2022, and throughout the week to facilitate future readiness for domestic rescue operations. The Boise Fire Department's Swiftwater/Dive Rescue Team joins the Idaho Army National Guard biannually for helicopter hoist training. (U.S. National Guard video by Master Sgt. Becky Vanshur)
keywords: Idaho National Guard, hoist rescue, Boise Fire Department, Black Hawk UH-60 helicopters, National Guard, U.S. Army
